items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of beach fire permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Amt Musterschlei, Am Markt 6, 24376 Musterkappeln.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18.11.2026, sent as simple letter (einfacher Brief). Per § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG SH, it is deemed notified (Bekanntgabe) on the 4th day after it was handed to the post (Aufgabe zur Post), assumed to be the document date. Counting 4 days from 18.11.: 19., 20., 21., 22.11.2026 -> the 4th day is Sunday 22.11.2026. Because postal delivery does not occur on a Sunday, the fictitious delivery date shifts to the next business day (established practice analogous to § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG / § 122 Abs. 2 AO case law), i.e. Monday 23.11.2026, which is the Bekanntgabe date. The one-month objection period runs under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (event-triggered period, day of event not counted) and ends under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB on the day of the following month that numerically corresponds to the day of the triggering event (23) -> 23.12.2026. That date is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Final deadline: 23.12.2026 (must reach the authority by this date, in writing or recorded orally at the office).

warnings: The exact date the letter was actually handed to the postal service (Aufgabe zur Post) is not stated separately from the letter's date; I assumed they are the same, which is the normal case but could shift the deadline by a day or two if mailing was delayed.

The shift of the fictitious delivery date from a Sunday to the next business day is based on established administrative-law practice rather than explicit statutory wording in the letter; double-check with the authority if the exact deadline is critical.
